result.title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
result.summary: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM supervision. Second, they treat the whole future clip as equally valuable, although most of it is irrelevant context information. We address this by defining a foresight score, from which we obtain a contrastive privilege advantage that drives the model to learn the most valuable future information. Since the score is intractable, we optimize a tractable lower-bound surrogate that interpolates this advantage, computed between the true and a random reference future, with a teacher-student distillation advantage; together, they amplify decision-relevant content information and suppress irrelevant context information. We call the resulting framework Future-OPSD. On open-ended prediction and closed-ended planning, Future-OPSD improves base models by up to 14.2 and 15.9 points without compromising general video understanding. Code will be available at https://jingchensun.github.io/future-opsd/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Future-OPSD：利用无标注的过去-未来视频对做 on-policy 自蒸馏，并定义 foresight score 与对比式特权优势，使 VLM 在预测未来事件或下一步动作时更关注决策相关的未来信息、抑制无关上下文。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「前景分数+对比特权优势」本质上是对哪些未来视觉证据值得学习的贡献分配与筛选机制，可供核查如何借鉴到 latent 视觉证据加权、轨迹监督与无关上下文抑制。
